notes: «كلاهما عن حماد بن زيد» joins the two co-transmitters in one level, so one group
the dashed «- قال أبو الربيع حدثنا حماد -» is Muslim's own aside on the same route: left out
«قال أبو قلابة وبدأ بالعيال» is Abu Qilaba's own remark with no isnad of its own: not a second route
the Prophet is the end of the chain; the Companion is Thawban
